title: Sound effects - Kenney CC0 audio and procedural generators (ZzFX, jsfxr, rFXGen)
summary: Get UI and game sound effects from Kenney's CC0 packs or synthesise originals with ZzFX, jsfxr and rFXGen, recording provenance.
description: Use when a short or Godot scene needs clicks, pops, whooshes, coins or impacts. Start with Kenney's CC0 audio packs, or synthesise original effects with ZzFX (MIT), jsfxr (Unlicense) or rFXGen (zlib) so no third-party sample is involved. Covers recording parameters as provenance and import.

source.notes: Describes https://kenney.nl/assets/category:Audio (checked 2026-10-10); contains no third-party media.
